title: Ukukhanyela Phakathi Kobuninzi
intro: Uzifumana uphakathi kwabantu abaneemarike ezigcwele urhwebo, kodwa izikali zabo zitsho ngokungathembekanga. Umthunywa ufikile kubo enezilumkiso ezicacileyo, kodwa bayahleka baze bajike, beqinisekile ngempumelelo yabo. Isibhakabhaka siqala ukuba mnyama, kodwa basibona njengentsikelelo yemvula. Ngoobani aba bantu?
clues: Sachuma kumazwe orhwebo nobutyebi, kodwa iintliziyo zethu zaba lukhuni.
Isithunywa size kuthi nemiqondiso evela eNkosini yethu, kodwa sahlekisa ngezilumkiso zakhe.
Sasisaziwa ngomsebenzi wethu, kodwa sasibaqhatha abantu ngokukhawuleza.
Sasihlala phakathi kwemithi exineneyo nezityalo eziluhlaza, kodwa sazithatha lula iintsikelelo zethu.
Xa ilifu elimnyama lisondela, savuya, sicinga ukuba liza kuzisa imvula kumhlaba wethu owomileyo.
Kunoko, elo lifu lakhupha isohlwayo esitshisayo, saza sabanjwa yintlungu yemini yomthunzi.
